Event reference excerpts, frozen 2026-10-15

USNO: Nautical Almanac Office, United States Naval Observatory,
The American Ephemeris and Nautical Almanac for the Year 1923,
Government Printing Office, Washington, 1921.
https://archive.org/details/in.ernet.dli.2015.515803
A United States federal government publication; the retained numerical
excerpts are public-domain source material. The scans remain at the provider.

NAOJ: Copyright National Astronomical Observatory of Japan.
Numerical prediction excerpts from the Ephemeris Computation Office and
NAOJ's astronomical outreach pages. Individual source URLs and receipts
are in sources.json; data retain NAOJ's terms, not the code's MIT licence.
ECO page content may be freely used, with acknowledgement requested:
https://eco.mtk.nao.ac.jp/koyomi/site/index.html.en
Outreach excerpts are used for scientific research and information
through a publication/application, within the stated permitted scope:
https://www.nao.ac.jp/en/terms/copyright.html
No program source, photographs, map imagery or provider keys are included.
Retain this credit and consult the original terms for a different use.

The workbench's authored tests and documentation use the repository's MIT
licence. Neither source institution endorses this workbench. The data here
are predictions from independent published sources, not observed contacts
or measurements of this workbench's accuracy.
